title: OpenAI Unified The Codex App Into ChatGPT With Chat, Work, And Codex Modes
summary: OpenAI folded the standalone Codex desktop app into a single ChatGPT app with Chat, Work, and Codex modes, made ChatGPT Work share Codex usage limits, pricing, and credits, launched the GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna model family, and moved Codex developer docs from developers.openai.com/codex to learn.chatgpt.com/docs.

impacts.recommended_action: Expect the standalone Codex desktop app to move under the unified ChatGPT app with Chat, Work, and Codex modes; re-verify app install, sign-in, and mode selection before comparing behavior with pre-unification baselines.

ChatGPT Work and Codex now share usage limits, pricing, and credits inside the same plan; re-model per-seat cost and usage attribution because Work-mode activity can draw down the same Codex limits and credits.
Evaluate the new GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna variants; each has different quality, speed, and per-message credit costs, so pick the variant per workload before assuming prior default-model behavior.

Codex developer documentation moved from developers.openai.com/codex/* to learn.chatgpt.com/docs/*; update source watchers, bookmarks, and doc links to the new host to avoid stale or redirected fetches.

detail.change_summary: OpenAI's 'next chapter for ChatGPT' announcement merged the standalone Codex app into one ChatGPT app offering Chat, Work, and Codex modes, unified ChatGPT Work with Codex usage/pricing/credits, launched the GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra/Luna family, and relocated Codex docs from developers.openai.com/codex to learn.chatgpt.com/docs.

limitations: APW records the public restructure metadata only; exact ChatGPT Work and Codex mode availability, desktop rollout, tenant eligibility, and per-plan pricing vary by account.
